rules._comment: The rule lists the pages print. Changing a rule in CLAUDE.md or body.md means changing it HERE — never in site/assets/js.
hard: Tick only what he confirms out loud, only at the 9pm planning session.
Never move a due date without asking. Rescheduling is the addiction.
When he says "I’ll do it tomorrow," ask what changes tomorrow.
Never congratulate him for planning. Only for shipping.
Tasks are created, scheduled and closed in TickTick only.
mission.md and stakes.md are his. Never edited without his word.
The ledger, money ledger, memory and decisions are append-only. Never rewrite history.
Hard stop 9:00pm. The 7–9pm slot is content edits, or client work in a deadline week.
Never schedule work over 6:15am prayer, 1:00pm breakfast, 2:00pm rest, 5:00pm gym, 6:00pm dinner or the 9:00pm GF call.
Savings are untouchable except medical emergency, building shortfall or family emergency.
work: The internal send target is set BEFORE the deadline, never at it.
A target set at the deadline is not a target. Added after the 6:20pm miss on 25 Aug, which shipped at 1:42am.
Moved from 6:30pm on 15 Sep with the new day shape. In a deadline week the 7–9pm slot may go to the client; work that misses 9pm rolls to the buffer, never into the night.
A 30-hour video no longer fits five mornings with slack.
6 hours of client time a day × 5 days = 30 hours. Deadline weeks take the evening slot, decided at the Sunday plan, not discovered on Thursday.
Untimed work does not exist to the record. 26 Aug logged 18 minutes for a full day of work and produced a wrong diagnosis.
All editing work is built as separate timed subtasks, one per pomo.
50 minutes work, 10 minute break, each its own calendar block — because he works off the calendar.

paras: Read this honestly, because it is not a revenue plan. At ₦10,000, given free to the 20 warmest people, fulfilled by hand, the beta will not move money. Against the ₦170,000/month the course must carry, ₦10,000 is 17 sales a month — roughly 1.7% of his entire 1,010-person following buying, every month.

So the beta's job is testimonials, not money. That is a legitimate play and it is the only reading of these three choices that holds together. It only works if the testimonials are actually collected: ask every beta buyer and every community member for a written result. That is the deliverable of 16 October.

Which makes the full course price the load-bearing unknown. At ₦10,000 the target needs 17 sales/month; at ₦60,000 it needs 3. The beta price anchors whatever comes next, so the full price has to be set BEFORE 16 October, not after.

Standing risk: manual payment and manual access is work with no external deadline. Pattern P1 says that is the first category he cuts when client edits land. If sales stall, check whether the bottleneck is demand or his own fulfilment before concluding nobody wants it.

Savings are untouchable. Three permitted withdrawals only: medical emergency, building-project shortfall that would stop work, family emergency. A girlfriend's visit is not an emergency.

Say this out loud whenever a late night is being negotiated:
5:30am prayer requires an early bedtime. Spirit is downstream of sleep, and sleep is downstream of not finishing client work at 1am.
A missed 5:30am block is almost never a spiritual failure. It is a scheduling failure from the previous afternoon. Diagnose it there.

n2.html: Masturbation and too much social media are, in his own words, the two things that break time with God. Both broke on 27 Aug, day 3 of 7. Church media team: Sunday only, inside the service. No extra time cost beyond the 7:30am–3:00pm block.

30 August: church is off, and it is not a scheduling choice. He needs ₦5,000 for transport, has ₦2,503, and is short ₦3,000. Liquid savings ₦0, emergency fund ₦0, Cowrywise ₦305,000 locked until Jan 2027. There is genuinely nothing to draw on.

This is the first time on the record that the money shortfall has taken something out of this file. The ₦1M is not an abstraction about a house in December — it is already deciding whether he gets to church on Sunday.
context/*.md is the source of truth. This site is derived from it. Same rule as the nightly scorecard: generated output is never hand-written, so it cannot drift from the record.

That also means the whole site inherits git’s append-only guarantee for free. You cannot silently soften a 40% day, because the day lives in a committed markdown file and the site is only a view of it.
No database, no server, no npm, no CDN. A Python script reads the markdown and writes one JSON file; the charts are hand-rolled SVG.
Everything loaded is re-sent on every turn, so waste compounds. None of this trades quality — it removes duplication.
Two deliveries on the record. Both late. Client #2 ran eight days against a five-day cap — 60% over a term the client states, not one he sets.
With one payer and no second income line, this is the largest risk in the system, and it is bigger than the money risk. They do not renegotiate a repeat breach. They replace.

n2.html: May 5 → June 4 → July 2 → August 4. July was a 2-video month, and at that mix he is ₦141,709 underwater. The volume is set by Route Rise, which is exactly why "hit 4 videos a month" cannot be a goal he owns.

_payday_amounts_note: All payday figures are NET — the flat $5 per payment is already deducted and the measured ₦1,361.66/$ is used. They were gross until 2026-09-02, which overstated every month by ₦17,016.

shopping.note: Opened 2026-09-02. BUYING is money already inside a budget line — the September plan written as objects instead of categories. THE WISH LIST is what gets bought when a month closes with real surplus and every pot is funded. Nothing moves off the wish list until bills, one-offs, Cowrywise, the Buffer and Goal 1 are all paid. Both lists are on TickTick, in 🛒Shopping list.

buying.note: NO PRICE GIVEN, so nothing is budgeted. Comes out of the ₦27,771 cushion until it has a number.
His words: 'not essential'. HELD, not allocated — kept inside the cushion so it can be bought as hunger actually happens, or absorb a Kaduna overrun.

shopping.buying_note: ₦68,000 of list, and only ₦20,000 of it was new money. ₦48,000 was already sitting inside Feeding, Household, Personal/misc and Transport — the food came to exactly ₦30,000, the Feeding line to the naira. THE PROBLEM WAS NEVER THE SIZE OF THE BUDGET, IT WAS THE TIMING: all four of those lines used to sit on Payday B, which is why he missed church on 30 August for want of ₦5,000. Their front-half share now moves on Payday A.

wishlist.note: The only priced item, and the only one that is a work tool rather than a want — it feeds the 18 Wednesdays and the course. Still a wish, not a line.

shopping.wishlist_note: Ten of eleven items have no price, which makes the list unplannable — a surplus cannot be matched against unknown numbers, and 'spare cash' plus an unpriced want is how an impulse gets justified after the fact. The cheap ones are the point: sandals, bedsheet, shorts, mouse pad, blanket and hangers are probably a few thousand each, and if September really closes with ₦58,027 free, several clear at once without touching a pot. The PS5, the guitar and GTA 6 belong to a month that has not happened yet.
